text.offer: Duke Akardius has requested my services to supply his troops, but unfortunately I have no one to take the supplies to him. Here are the arrows to be delivered; I am sure the Duke will pay you for your troubles. Remember that you are bound to deliver the supplies. For some reason I trust you, though.
text.complete: Thank you. This is but the first delivery of many. May it foster good trade relations for years to come. Here, please take this.
